title: DeepSeek-R1 incentivizes reasoning in LLMs through reinforcement learning
authors: DeepSeek-AI (corporate author; the arXiv record lists the individual authors)
description: Nature article (arXiv title 'DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning') reporting that 'the reasoning abilities of LLMs can be incentivized through pure reinforcement learning (RL), obviating the need for human-labeled reasoning trajectories'. DeepSeek-R1-Zero is trained from DeepSeek-V3-Base with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and rule-based rewards; DeepSeek-R1 adds a multistage pipeline (cold-start data, RL, rejection sampling and supervised fine-tuning, and a second RL stage with model-based helpfulness and safety rewards). The paper reports benchmark results, an ethics and safety statement, limitations (structured output and tool use, token efficiency, language mixing, prompting, software-engineering tasks, reward hacking) and distillation into smaller dense models.
codeLicence: github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1: MIT License, 'Copyright (c) 2023 DeepSeek'. The repository holds a README, figures and a PDF, not training code; the paper says the inference script is in the DeepSeek-V3 repository.
rightsNotes: Nature version: 'This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License' (PMC copy and nature.com 'Rights and permissions', read 2026-10-31).
arXiv version: arXiv's non-exclusive distribution licence (nonexclusive-distrib/1.0) only, which grants no reuse rights; it is read-only reference.

Host terms: nature.com's Website Terms prohibit access 'by any means other than through a normal web browser in the generally-accepted manner', and PMC prohibits automated article downloads outside its OAI-PMH, FTP and Cloud services. The CC BY version is cited, not imported.

Weights: the README and the Hugging Face card state 'This code repository and the model weights are licensed under the MIT License'; the distilled models derive from Qwen2.5 (originally Apache 2.0) and from Llama 3.1 and 3.3 (Llama licences). Data samples (rejection-sampling and RL prompts) are in the GitHub repository, archived on Zenodo (doi 10.5281/zenodo.15753193, 'deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1: v1.0.0', 2025-06-27, MIT License). Corniversity does not download or run the models.
